Title: Verify discount lines to QuickBooks are capped in whole cents (largest-remainder) so they sum exactly to the floored subtotal
Permissions Required: See Financial Data + flag ON + active QuickBooks connection
Preconditions: 1. QuickBooks connected; a WO where stacked MULTIPLE discount lines drive the net subtotal below $0.00 (floor applies).
Steps To Reproduce:
1. Invoice/sync the WO.
2. Inspect the discount line amounts sent to QuickBooks.
Expected Result:
1. The discount lines are capped so they sum exactly to the floored net subtotal and never fall below it.
